scope: Git-tracked files under src/ with extensions .cs, .razor, .py, .ts, .js, or .sh; paths are repository-relative.

status_definitions.pending: Full-file review not verified; portions may have been reviewed.
status_definitions.completed: Full-file review and any required taxonomy updates verified.

date_updated_meaning: Date of the most recent taxonomy review of this source file, including partial reviews (YYYY-MM-DD), or null when the review date is unknown.
